name: Daimeng Robotics
summary:
Daimeng Robotics, also branded Daimon Robotics, develops tactile sensing and dexterous manipulation technology for embodied AI. The company grew from a Hong Kong University of Science and Technology research team, began operations in 2023 and has its headquarters in Shenzhen with research activity in Hong Kong.

Its products include high-resolution visual-tactile sensors, teleoperation systems with force or touch feedback, and tools for collecting multimodal manipulation data. The company combines vision, touch, language and action in its data and model development. Its role spans enabling components and manipulation infrastructure, supporting researchers and robot developers working to improve how machines perceive contact and handle objects.
